jobs.description: Our Offer:- Exciting jobs at interesting companies such as Airbus Operations, Airbus Defence & Space, and the aerospace supply industry- Attractive and fair salary conditions- Comprehensive employee benefits program "Orizon PlusPunkte"- Training measures suiting your tasks and activities- Up to 30 days of annual leave- Personal support and qualified advice at the Unit Aviation offices, e.g.in Hamburg-Finkenwerder, Stade, Augsburg, Munich, or BremenYour Prospective Job:For our renowned customer Airbus Operations you are acting as Flight Physics Software Developer (m/f/d) at the location Bremen. In this position you will design, build, and maintain world-class software solutions that support both current aircraft programs and the future of aviation.Your Responsibilities:- Translate complex Flight Physics requirements into scalable, maintainable, and production-ready cloud applications- Participate in fast-paced Agile sprints, maintaining existing codebases while driving technical improvements and optimization- Support transnational project management activities- Identify optimisation potentials- Ensure clear process and procedural governance- Define and execute robust testing strategies to guarantee high software qualityYour Profile:- Completed studies in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics or comparable- Several years of professional experience as Developer / Software Engineer, in Project Management and IT / Information Systems- Good knowledge in Project Management- Basic knowledge in Change Management and Process Management- Knowledge of web authentication standards (OIDC, OAuth 2.0) is a plus- User skills in NestJS and TypeScript- Skills in Git and Agile methodologies as well as in Architecture & Tooling e.g. Nx Monorepo, Containerisation (Docker) is a plus- Fluent English and German basic skills spoken and written- Willingness to travel (1-2 times per quarter, mainly to the UK and France)Your Partner:Orizon GmbH is your capable partner when it comes to standing out from the crowd on the labour market. With our individual advice you will find the job that suits you best. Being among the top fifteen German HR service providers, our company’s range of services includes the personnel secondment and placement of both skilled workers and executives of all professional fields.Orizon's “Aviation” unit is the specialist for personnel secondment in the aerospace sector and – thanks to its excellent industry experience – offers you interesting perspectives in this field. You have an appropriate qualification and are interested in working in the aerospace sector? Or have you already gained experience in aerospace? Then, we are exactly the right partner for you.Bewerbung und Rückfragen:Wir freuen uns auf Bewerbungen (unter Angabe von Verfügbarkeit und Gehaltsvorstellung) gerne per E-Mail an bewerbung.aviation@orizon.de oder über unser Bewerbungsmodul auf dieser Seite.Für Fragen steht Herr Bachmann gerne unter der Telefonnummer +49 421 1603772 zur Verfügung.Beim hier angegebenen Gehalt sind unter Umständen nicht alle Bestandteile (bspw. Branchenzuschläge, Weihnachtsgeld, Schicht-Boni o.ä.) berücksichtigt. Das verbindliche Gehalt ist im persönlichen Gespräch zu klären.Weitere Informationen finden Sie unter orizon.deWir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer personenbezogenen Daten ernst: www.orizon.de/de/datenschutzvereinbarungen
